description: rampart_20x_playground Codespaces record: the demo record's plugins and population, booted by a GitHub Codespace launched from this repository. profile_kind is deploy, not dev_local: the instance is served on a forwarded hostname and the dev passkey replay does not apply. Sign-in is GitHub device flow admitting only the account that opened the Codespace (owner_only), the auth section tap's own codespace_demo profile uses. Every plugin is pinned as in the demo record, from public repositories; the hourly jobs need outbound network access. The deployment is a mock-up and the vulnerabilities are real.

auth.description: One provider, device flow, admitting exactly one account. The redirect flow cannot serve this deployment at all — a Codespace's hostname is generated per instance, so a callback URL would need wildcard matching against a GitHub-owned domain shared with every Codespace user (GitHub advises against it) AND a client_secret shipped in a public template, where it is not a secret. Device flow has no callback and needs no secret, so the only credential here is a PUBLIC client_id that may be committed. KNOWN GAP, recorded rather than papered over: this admits the owner but grants them no ROLE. `initial_admins` / `initial_grants` are keyed on a VERIFIED EMAIL, and nothing can know the visitor's address in advance — the Codespace token is repository-scoped, so `/user` may not be readable and the public `/users/<login>` returns an email only when the visitor has published one. Deriving it would therefore fail silently for most people. Observed live 2026-09-21: an admitted account got 403 on `/` with its session cookie and 302 without, i.e. authenticated with no role. The right fix is a grant keyed on the same numeric identity `owner_only` already matches, which is a code change and its own issue — not an email guess wired in here. `allow_admin_lockout` is true for that reason: with no resolvable admin address, the last-admin invariant would otherwise abort the boot of a demo that is working as designed.

providers.description: GitHub OAuth App Ov23li7DZ17aqmEpyHSL (org-owned, unified-systems-com, Device Flow enabled). The client_id is PUBLIC by design and carries no secret — see the auth section description. Proven live 2026-09-21: page renders, /start/ reaches GitHub, a granted token establishes a session, and ExternalIdentity is keyed on the NUMERIC subject.

plugins.note: Installed after git_core and compliance_core: each entry is installed on its own, so a sibling distribution it depends on must already be present (github_core 0.13.0 requires git-core-tap, tap-plugin-compliance-core and tap-plugin-identity-core).

Installed after compliance_core: the coverage_snapshot collector subclasses compliance_core's SearchSnapshotCollector (first shipped in v0.8.7), and the classification mapping bundle's hourly Schedule targets that collector.

The PAIN method for FedRAMP VDR (the stackArmor method). Installed after fedramp_20x_vdr, whose finding reach its runners import; it seeds the sixteen archetype nodes the pain bundle's stamps point at.
Pinned by its release tag v0.1.0 (commit 28942f2), the first release of rampart-20x-tap (2026-11-05).

Self entry: pinned to its own release v0.2.0 by tag and by commit, like every other plugin. v0.2.0 predates this record, which reaches the Codespace by a mount from the workspace, not from the installed package; a release that carries a newer record moves both fields.

steps.note: TAP admin pages and grid landing.
The dcom axis, so the `design` dimension node exists for seeded entities to carry.
aws_core's vocabulary dimension nodes only; its pages and region seed arrive when a page mounts them.
fedramp_20x_ksi's vocabulary dimension nodes only; its KSI seed and pages stay out until a page needs them, and its hourly schedule is the next step.
fedramp_20x_ksi's hourly KSI catalog Schedule (minute 17); the collector's only egress is raw.githubusercontent.com and it needs no credential.
vuln_mosaic's hourly refresh Schedule (minute 41), so the local CVE stores stay current.
The 53 timeframe rows the PAIN deadline reads.
Own GRIFT: the sixteen archetypes the program stamps point at.
This plugin's own bundles: keystone and dimensions. Last, so every dimension it references already exists.

Gives every open vulnerability-linked finding its all-null VDR max evaluation, once, after the playground's findings are seeded, so the VDR max page has evaluations to show. The first boot runs before the queue worker exists, so this step cannot finish there and gives up after 20 s (the preflight, which would wait 60 s for the same missing worker, is off); the second boot, run once the worker is up, completes it.
